descriptionChirho: Masculine noun חֹשֶׁן designating the priestly breastpiece (or breastplate of judgment), a square pouch set with twelve precious stones representing the twelve tribes, worn over the high priest's chest and attached to the ephod (Exod 25:7; 28:4, 15–30; 29:5; 35:9, 27; 39:8–21; Lev 8:8). All 25 occurrences describe the same ritual garment. The two clusters differ only in the presence or absence of the article (הַחֹשֶׁן 'the breastpiece' vs. חֹשֶׁן 'breastpiece of'). Translations are uniform: eng 'breastpiece', spa 'pectoral', hin सीनाबन्द/चपरास, arb صُدرَة, kor 흉판, swa 'kifuko cha kifuani.'
